== English Theed Palace comparison ==
Aglets announces the replacement as effective immediately and expressly gives Sorry About The Mess as an example of another way to fire Booma. The published change removes the in-battle restriction where a card or rule permits firing out of battle. Both versions retain the Fambaa deployment and strict less-than destiny threshold, and the opponent chooses the card lost. D-E1 printed slip and current publisher full photo agree with text of the announcement.

Decipher, [https://archive.org/details/youtube-mqQxI_VPlTc ''Radio Free Decipher'' #106], 30 November 2001, 11:07–11:17, announces 12 December. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20011212170750id_/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/expansions/theedpalace/index.html expansion page] was online that day.
